data:
The Accessibility Requirements Tool (ART) helps federal agencies identify and apply the appropriate accessibility requirements from the Section 508 Standards for Information and Communication Technology (ICT) product development and acquisitions. Through a guided process, ART generates tailored accessibility requirements for project and procurement documentation.

While ART identifies the Section 508 requirements that apply to an acquisition, the Solicitation Review Tool (SRT) uses AI-assisted analysis to review solicitation documents and recommend improvements to accessibility requirements language. Together, these tools help agencies create more accurate, compliant solicitations and build accessibility into the acquisition process from the start.
